stop_limits: Native TUI interrupt command dispatched through official endpoint; physical keyboard Escape not validated.
Root cancellation alone did not stop the separately created member. Experimental controller observed native MessageAbortedError then cancelled exactly its registered member.
Four measured processes exited and heartbeat files stopped growing. No claim for arbitrary detached processes, native background subagent tools or external effects.
This passed automatic stop path is an experimental controller, not the production Orbit TaskRuntime.
pitfalls: Direct calls to native SDK during plugin initialization blocked startup; deferred until after initialization succeeded.
The session.interrupt spelling returned true from the legacy TUI endpoint but did not dispatch; its accepted alias is session_interrupt.
One heartbeat fixture syntax error was corrected before recording live-process stop evidence.

On this resumed fixture, --model opencode/deepseek-v4-flash displayed OpenCode Zen, but the next TUI submission still used provider deepseek. Explicit model in native prompt_async used provider opencode. This is an observed entry-path limitation, not a general diagnosis of all resume paths.
